notes.title: Project News: First Gameplay Video
notes.notes: [p]Today I want to share a short but important gameplay snippet from [i]Red Passport: Ticket to Russia[/i].[/p][p align="start"]In this brief video, the protagonist takes their very first steps through the airport. It’s only half a minute of walking, but it sets the mood: the interior, passing NPCs, the murmur of the crowd, and announcements echoing through the speakers. For me, it was important that even such a seemingly simple moment — just walking — feels like a genuine part of the journey.[/p][p align="start"]The airport is the starting point of a long adventure. From here, the player sets off toward the flight, the train, new cities, and plenty of mysteries. I tried to capture that thrilling sense of anticipation — when your suitcase is packed, the ticket is in your hand, and the road across Russia lies ahead.[/p][p align="start"]For me, this is a small but very meaningful step: the environment is coming to life and getting closer to the vision I had from the very beginning. In upcoming updates, I’ll be gradually sharing new locations and details that bring both me and you closer to the journey all the way to Vladivostok.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eMpnk0km6Rs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: First Details of Red Passport: Ticket to Russia
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there! I’m excited to share the very first details about [b]Red Passport: Ticket to Russia[/b] — my adventure about a long journey across the country.[/p][p align="start"]The story begins in a cozy apartment: this is the starting point where you’ll gather your belongings and take your first steps toward the road ahead. But what follows is a whole chain of important stages:[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]✈️ [b]The Airplane[/b]
The flight is not just a “loading screen.” Inside the cabin you’ll spend real time, interacting with passengers, having dialogues, completing small tasks and experiencing unique moments that turn hours in the air into a true part of the adventure.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]🏙️ [b]The Big City[/b]
After landing, you’ll find yourself in a large, bustling city. Here you’ll need to explore, solve challenges, and navigate your way to the railway station. The atmosphere of the streets, the sounds, and the tiny details that only appear during a trip will all play a role.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]🚆 [b]The Train to Vladivostok[/b]
The culmination of your journey is the legendary train ride across the whole country. The carriage is full of stories, dialogues, and encounters. What matters most is the feeling of the long road itself: the changing landscapes outside the window and the discoveries waiting at every stop.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]🌍 [b]Atmosphere[/b]
Sounds, sights from windows, and environmental details — all of these make the journey feel alive, as though you’re truly moving from one city to another, not just loading into a new scene.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]For me, [b]Red Passport: Ticket to Russia[/b] is not only about reaching Vladivostok. It’s about the journey itself — every step, every encounter, every small discovery along the way, from your very first moments in the apartment to the last city in the Far East.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for following the game from the very beginning! The most exciting things are still ahead 🚂✨[/p]
